plan_item: 77.44.7.A — Inspector declared appliesTo and layout container parity

finding.defect: renderRegistryInspector() omitted nodeType when querying flex/grid groups. The visible Inspector therefore bypassed each property’s appliesTo declaration and could show Flex/Grid container controls on types absent from the capability contract.
finding.fix: All Inspector group queries now include the selected node type. A shared LAYOUT_TYPES module is the single source for layout preset eligibility and container-level Flex/Grid appliesTo declarations. Grid/Flex modes still decide which contextual field appears, while item fields continue to depend on the parent layout.
finding.regression_revealed: The first post-fix responsive Chromium run exposed grid.columns missing on the supported generic container because its static appliesTo list only contained grid. The property metadata now uses the canonical layout-container list; the same full responsive test passes after this correction.
finding.reuse_review: Inspected and reused the project’s existing Property Registry appliesTo filtering and layout-context resolver. The small shared domain list is project-specific; no third-party code or dependency is appropriate or added.
